name: allyproof
description: WCAG 2.2 accessibility checks and AI-assisted fixes, starting with HTML.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces AI Review uses only GitHub Copilot, so a workspace cannot send your code to another endpoint. With a local model it is disabled until you trust the workspace.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No Findings in the open files. Open an HTML, Vue, Svelte, JSX, TSX, Astro or Angular file to check it.
[Get Started](command:workbench.action.openWalkthrough?%22notaisu.allyproof%23allyproof.gettingStarted%22)

languageModelTools.name: a11y_check
languageModelTools.userDescription: Check a file or proposed code against WCAG 2.2 AA with Allyproof's static Check.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs Allyproof's deterministic WCAG 2.2 AA Check on frontend code and returns its Findings (1-based line, WCAG criteria, rule, severity, message, explanation, help URL) and the criteria it lists as Needs Review because the Check cannot decide them from source. Pass filePath to check a workspace file as it is open in the editor, code with languageId to check proposed code, or filePath and code to check proposed code for that file, for example to verify a fix before applying it. Call it before reviewing accessibility yourself and only review what it cannot decide.

filePath.description: Workspace-relative or absolute path of the file to check.

code.description: Proposed code to check instead of the file's current text.

languageId.description: Language id of code, for example html, typescriptreact or angular for an Angular component template. Defaults to the language of filePath.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Allyproof
walkthroughs.description: Check your frontend code against WCAG 2.2 AA while you write it.

steps.title: Your code is already being checked
steps.description:
Findings appear in the Problems panel as you type, with a quick fix where there is one safe edit.
[Show Findings](command:allyproof.findings.focus)

steps.title: Set up AI Review
steps.description:
Review semantic problems with GitHub Copilot, your own keys added to Copilot, or a local model.
[Choose a provider](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22allyproof.aiReview.provider%22)

steps.title: Use the Skill in your own agent
steps.description:
GitHub Copilot chat has the Skill and the a11y_check tool built in; other agents can use the same Skill.
[Open Chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)

steps.title: Ignore and configure rules
steps.description:
Ignore single Findings, turn rules off or change their severity, and fix on save.
[Open Allyproof settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22allyproof%22)

allyproof.aiReview.auto.description: Also start an AI Review of the active file when it is saved. Off by default: code is only sent to the AI provider when you start a review.

allyproof.rules.markdownDescription: Turn Check rules off or change the severity of their Findings, by rule id, for example `{ "image-alt": "off", "jsx-a11y-x/alt-text": "error" }`. Check Findings are warnings by default. To ignore a single Finding, put `<!-- allyproof-ignore <rule id> -->` (in JSX `{/* allyproof-ignore <rule id> */}`) on the line above it.

enumDescriptions: GitHub Copilot models, including your own keys added to Copilot.
A local model behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, such as LM Studio or Ollama. Your code stays on your machine.
allyproof.aiReview.provider.description: Where AI Review sends the code. In untrusted workspaces AI Review uses only GitHub Copilot; with a local model it is disabled until you trust the workspace, so your code never leaves your machine.

allyproof.aiReview.localEndpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint of the local model server: http://localhost:1234/v1 for LM Studio, http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.

allyproof.aiReview.localModel.description: Model the local server runs AI Review with, for example qwen2.5-coder. Empty uses the first model the server lists.

allyproof.check.fixOnSave.description: Apply the Check's deterministic fixes that guess nothing (such as removing aria-hidden from the body) when a file is saved. Off by default: Allyproof never changes your code unless you ask. They are also available as quick fixes and under source.fixAll; a fix that guesses, such as adding lang="en", is a quick fix only.

scripts.verify: npm run lint -- --max-warnings=0 && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:gate && npm run test:bundle-gate
